definition: Research into techniques that allow humans (or AI-assisted humans) to effectively supervise and evaluate AI systems whose capabilities may exceed what a human can directly verify.
details: Scalable oversight is a central challenge in AI alignment, since as models tackle increasingly complex tasks, it becomes harder for unaided humans to reliably judge whether outputs are correct, safe, or aligned with intent.
story: Picture a parachute packed by a second pair of hands: nobody plans to need it, but everyone is glad it was checked. In plain words: Research into techniques that allow humans (or AI-assisted humans) to effectively supervise and evaluate AI systems whose capabilities may exceed what a human can directly verify. Here is how it actually plays out: Scalable oversight is a central challenge in AI alignment, since as models tackle increasingly complex tasks, it becomes harder for unaided humans to reliably judge whether outputs are correct, safe, or aligned with intent. Caution is not the enemy of progress — it is the reason progress gets to keep going. That deliberate caution is Scalable Oversight.
